INSERT INTO flow_trigger_events (flow_type, scope_data, event_type, event_time, event_payload, prev_event_id)
            SELECT $1,
                   $2,
                   value ->> 'event_type',
                   value ->> 'event_time',
                   value ->> 'event_payload',
                   value ->> 'prev_event_id'
            FROM json_each($3)
            ORDER BY key
